searchText: Hello I am a 19 year old cs student who is very passionate about ethereum. I was wondering if there is any way for me to contribute to the development of ethereum. <@!458053965423312910> what are you interested in contributing _to_? This channel ahs a lot of examples if you scroll up, and basically everything is open source, so it's mostly a challenge of finding what interests you + fits your skillset (or something you want to learn) 😄 I want to learn more about the consensus algorithm or and work with the client side, but honestly the biggest problem is that I am curious about all I'd recommend starting here: https://benjaminion.xyz/eth2-annotated-spec/phase0/beacon-chain/
